issues: ISSUE-1 (minor): AC2's browser click-through steps (600px/1024px viewport load, click UZ/RU, verify document.documentElement.lang) were not executed with an actual browser — no browser automation tool was available in this execution environment. Substituted with equivalent server-rendered HTML, LocaleSwitcher.tsx source, and globals.css breakpoint evidence supporting the same PASS conclusion. Recommend RELEASE-VALIDATOR perform a real browser click-through if a browser tool is available at that stage.

ISSUE-2 (informational): The spec's literal grep command `grep -o '
.*
'` (AC2 and AC5) over-matches to the end of the document on this real page because POSIX grep's .* is greedy and many more closings follow .lang — not an application defect. Verified the .lang div's actual content with `grep -oE '
(]*>[A-Z]*)*
'` instead, which matched the spec's expected string exactly in all 4 instances checked. Recommend updating the test spec's grep pattern for future runs.
